Bombay HC: Residence Proof Essential for RTE Neighbourhood Quota Admissions

The Bombay High Court has ruled that proof of residence is an essential requirement for admissions under the Right to Education (RTE) Act's neighbourhood schools quota. This decision upholds the rejection of an admission application where residence proof was not provided. The ruling clarifies the mandatory eligibility conditions for students seeking admission through this specific quota.
